sentences.text: The Lion King 's Timon & Pumbaa , often simply referred to as Timon & Pumbaa , is an American animated television series created by Walt Disney Television Animation .	Walt Disney Television	Walt Disney Television	Walt Disney Television Animation	Disney Television Animation	 The Lion King	 The Lion King	American	Television in the United States	animated television series	animated television series	The Lion King	The Lion King
It centers on Timon the meerkat and Pumbaa the warthog from Disney 's 1994 film The Lion King .	 The Lion King	 The Lion King	The Lion King	The Lion King

The show ran for three seasons on CBS , Disney Channel , Toon Disney , and in syndication as a part of The Disney Afternoon .	CBS	CBS	Toon Disney	Toon Disney	Disney Channel	Disney Channel	The Disney Afternoon	The Disney Afternoon
It aired from September 8 , 1995 to September 24 , 1999 .
It is also the first Lion King related media to show humans , as humans were not present in the movie .
It is the first of two television series to be based on the film , the second being The Lion Guard .	The Lion Guard	The Lion Guard

In 2004 , Timon and Pumbaa starred in their own released feature film The Lion King 1 1/2 , a direct-to-video adaptation of the television series to the first of two films .	 The Lion King	 The Lion King	The Lion King	The Lion King

Robert Guillaume , Matthew Broderick , Cam Clarke , Julie Kavner and Estelle Harris , Nathan Lane , Quinton Flynn , Kevin Schon , Ernie Sabella , Scott Bullock and Jerry Stiller , provided the voices of Rafiki , Simba , Timon 's Mother , Timon , Pumbaa , Fred and Uncle Max respectively in The Lion King 1 1/2 , and two seasons of television series episodes Mombasa-In-Law/The Laughing Hyenas : TV Dinner , Once Upon a Timon .
